remarks: Stunning colonial featuring private back yard and pool!! - Located on a quiet cul-de-sac, this home offers tons of living space and options - Just 3 minutes to Rowayton train and 5 minutes to the center of Rowayton - Currently set up as a 7 bedroom home, with 3.5 newly renovated bathrooms! - Light and bright kitchen with granite counters looks into dining space and through sliding doors out to the pool! - Large pool area features awesome pool cabana, great for parties & entertaining! - Primary bedroom currently set up on main floor features vaulted ceiling with shiplap and exposed beams - This room could also be set up as a living / family room - Six additional bedrooms, some currently set up as huge walk-in closets - Newly renovated bathrooms with tile showers, glass doors, new tile floors, new vanities, and new custom mirrors featuring LED lighting! - Custom lighting and wall treatment on staircase - Finished basement for additional living space - Private back yard also features fenced-in garden area! - 2 car attached garage - Pets considered on a case by case basis
